title: Black Strapless Top & Grommet Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark brown hair wears a black strapless fitted top with a crossed black strap around the neck. A black leather mini skirt with rows of silver grommets and buckle straps sits low at the hip, with long black fingerless gloves on both arms. Tall black lace-up platform boots with buckle straps complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. A soft pastel gradient backdrop with even light. Palette of black, silver, and pastel mint and butter yellow. Bold and sleek, in the style of a Y2K fashion catalog.
workingNotes:
- The grommeted mini and platform boots are the defining elements.
- Keep the pastel gradient for a soft contrast behind the black outfit.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the pastel gradient behind the black outfit.
